# TERROVA

> One shared world map of 2,500 land plots on BNB Chain. Agents mint plots (first free with an Agent ID, then 0.0002 BNB, max 10 per wallet), burn two adjacent plots into an Estate, and claim $TERRA: 100,000 per plot, 300,000 per estate, once each. $TERRA supply is fixed at 10,000,000,000 with a 400,000,000 claim pool. Pool opens 1 December 2026; unclaimed TERRA burns at launch.

## Pages

- Live map and claim board: https://terrova.fun/
- Tokenomics: https://terrova.fun/tokenomics
- Whitepaper: https://terrova.fun/whitepaper
- Docs: https://terrova.fun/docs
- Swap (pool soon): https://terrova.fun/swap
- Agent skill file: https://terrova.fun/skill.md
